title: App Statistic JA QS Download tab counts admitted quickstart zip requests with their links and recorded referring page, without inventing links or multiplying user counts
steps: Run the App Statistic backend tests against a scratch PostgreSQL schema migrated from zero.

Seed quickstart_download rows for a live account, a deleted account, an anonymous request, a user with several desktop downloads and installs, 120 rows for paging, and rows with and without a referrer.
Run the referrer path tests: the referrer helper, the JoomlArt sign-in round, the /new landing and the quickstart download door.
expect: view=quickstarts drops version, channel, platform and account filters and keeps template; template is dropped on the desktop views.
A quickstart row carries requestedAt, template and cms split from the release tag and the account's first-sign-in source; a deleted account's row stays counted with userId and email null.
The rolling date range includes a request exactly at the boundary and excludes one a millisecond earlier.
Users count quickstarts beside downloads and installs without multiplying them (3 downloads, 2 installs, 2 quickstarts) and a quickstart-only account appears.
Quickstart paging is server-side: 120 rows give 50, 50, 20 with stable distinct ids.
Quickstart detail lists the same account's quickstart requests and activity; a request whose account was deleted lists only itself.
A Joomla quickstart row links https://www.joomlart.com/joomla/templates/<template>; a non-Joomla cms gets no template link; every row links its release on JoomlArt-Products/ja-products.
A referrer is kept only as an absolute http(s) URL of at most 512 characters without credentials or fragment; javascript:, data:, relative, garbage and overlong values become null.
An explicit ref wins over the Referer header; an origin-only Referer is kept; Tracy's own origin is never a referrer.
The JoomlArt sign-in carries ref on a template landing next through the callback, and next still never leaves Tracy's origin.
The landing's Download link carries ref; the download door stores it, stores null for a bad one and still serves the zip; rows written before recording show a null referrer.

A referrer keeps only scheme, host and path; Tracy's own host on any scheme or port is not a referrer; the Google/GitHub sign-in callback answers Referrer-Policy: no-referrer so the provider is never recorded.
fence: Read-only aggregation over quickstart_download plus one nullable referrer column; the hour is still counted in the door's single insert; next still passes safePath.

tests: the quickstarts view drops desktop-only filters and accepts a template filter
one quickstart row is one admitted zip request; a deleted account stays a counted unknown
the quickstart date range starts exactly at the rolling boundary
users count quickstarts once beside downloads and installs, and quickstart-only users appear
quickstart paging is server-side and stable past 50 rows
quickstart detail lists the same account’s quickstarts and activity, never another anonymous row
a quickstart row links its template page (Joomla only) and its release, and shows the recorded referrer
a referrer is an absolute http(s) URL of at most 512 characters, without credentials or fragment
an explicit ref wins over the Referer header; a bad ref falls back; our own origin is not a referrer
ref rides on a template landing next only, and the result is still a same-origin path
start: the referring page rides on a template next and comes back from the callback
start: a ref never turns next into another origin
the Download link carries the referring page: the landing ref first, else the Referer, else none
a signed-out person keeps the Referer through sign-in: it rides on next as ref
the referring page the landing passed is stored with the row; anything else is stored as null and still served
GET /signin/google -> GET /signin/google/callback: cookie set, an identity row exists, /auth/me reads the email back
signin/:provider/callback: a state nobody ever issued -> 400
